description: Returns City of Reykjavík municipal swimming pool opening hours (regular weekly and holiday schedules) from reykjavik.is, current open-now status in Atlantic/Reykjavik time, and link to live visitor counts.

open_now_only.description: Only return pools currently open in Atlantic/Reykjavik time (default false).

pool.description: Optional pool name filter (e.g. Laugardalslaug, Sundhöll, Vesturbæjarlaug).

name: get_pools
title: Get Reykjavík Swimming Pool Hours
